definitions.gloss: all day, the whole day, throughout the day
definitions.explanation: From morning until evening without interruption. A formal word often seen in written notices, schedules, and announcements.

examples.japanese: {終日|しゅうじつ}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終日|しゅうじつ}⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{終日|しゅうじつ}⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧となります。
examples.english: The road will be closed all day due to construction.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-style word that functions as both a noun and an adverb. Often seen on signs, notices, and schedules. In casual speech, ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧ is preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終日|しゅうじつ}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧: open all day
- {終日|しゅうじつ}⟦{運休|うんきゅう}→運休：06807_unkyuu⟧: out of service all day
- {終日|しゅうじつ}⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧: closed to traffic all day
- {終日|しゅうじつ}⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: no smoking all day

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧ (all day long) is the everyday equivalent. {終日|しゅうじつ} is more formal and concise, making it ideal for signs and official announcements.
